name: FiveTaco
requirements: Software/tools aimed at solopreneurs; ~10 categories (marketing, productivity, ecommerce, etc.)
Account required before submitting (per teardowns; the /submit page is JS-gated)
The form is a single field: paste your product URL - 'we'll start collecting all the goods' (they scrape the rest)
preparation: Polish your site's title, meta description, and Open Graph image - those become the listing
A clean product URL to paste (no other fields to prepare)
workflow: Create an account / log in on fivetaco.com
Paste the product URL into the single input and press 'Submit product'
Note the UX quirk: the page gives no visible confirmation - no redirect, no message (per SubmitMap teardown)
watchFor: The form silently clears after submit - no success state; verify later by checking whether the product page exists
Listings carry three outbound links with ?ref=fivetaco appended (rel=noopener noreferrer, followed)
Community mechanics exist (daily like/login/submit streaks, leaderboard, reviews page per product)
Third-party data marks it 'freemium' - paid featured options may exist, but no paid tier was observed in the submit flow
countsAsLive: A public product page exists at fivetaco.com/products/<slug> with up to three followed links back to your site.
unknowns: Review/approval time (site states nothing; third parties estimate 3-7 days)
Whether rejected/duplicate URLs produce any feedback
